subject: APM
body: EV = £60,000, AC = £40,000. What is the cost performance index (CPI)?
explanation: CPI = EV ÷ AC = 1.5. Under or on budget.

subject: APM
body: EV = £52,000, AC = £40,000. What is the cost variance (CV)?
explanation: CV = EV − AC = £12,000. Zero or positive means on or under budget.

subject: APM

explanation: CPI = EV ÷ AC = 0.82. Over budget.
